Owl’s Memory Magic

Age 4–5 YearsClass 30 · LogicSkill Spotting what’s missing

Apple, star, car, leaf, cupcake — one flew away. Look closely and tap what is missing.

Play the puzzle game ↓Print the worksheet ↓Play with a finger, a stylus or a mouse. Instructions are spoken aloud.
PLAY · SPOTTING WHAT’S MISSING

Owl’s Memory Magic

The right panel copied the left one, but one thing is missing! Tap what disappeared.

Something is missing from the second panel. What is it?

Magic eye!

The blue toy car vanished — you spotted it.

FOR GROWN-UPS

Why this adventure helps.

This game trains spotting what’s missing on the puzzle picture itself: the question is spoken aloud, the answers are pictures, and a miss brings a gentle hint instead of a penalty. Ask your child to explain the rule out loud — saying the “why” is the whole skill.

Prefer paper? The Owl’s Memory Magic worksheet prints the same puzzle with room to draw, sort and circle — and a grown-up answer line. Printing never marks anything complete.
